products.title: Ark
products.description: A protected local library: knowledge, compute, power, configuration and restart materials that stay useful when the internet, the grid or ordinary infrastructure is not. Four tiers — Library, Librarian, Archivist, Athenaeum — in a mini case, a .30-cal, a .50-cal and a 20-cal, with an external Meshtastic communications sled.
products.narration: What in your house still works when the power goes out? These cases hold a library, a computer, and their own power, sealed and ready. The book you just saw talks to them by radio, so the knowledge sits here and travels to whoever needs it. Not for the end of the world. For the week a storm takes the grid down.
products.priceDetail: Library $299 · Librarian $529 · Archivist $999 · Athenaeum $1,999. Communications sled sold separately

products.title: Astrolabe
products.description: A tactile, glanceable instrument for inquiry. The first production beta is forming now.
products.narration: How many times a day do you pick up your phone without deciding to? This is the opposite. A small round instrument you glance at, which tells you one thing and then lets you go. Everything else here grew out of it.
products.priceDetail: The 1.75C round instrument. Beta reservation $49, refundable or credited in full · members $153

products.title: XDJ
products.description: A toddler-friendly interface for learning music and sound on the Pioneer XDJ-RX2: rhythm, cause and effect, and tactile play, without exposing a professional DJ workflow. A deck a small child can be handed.
products.narration: Have you watched a toddler find the one button that does something and press it four hundred times? This is a real DJ deck with a child's way in: rhythm, and cause and effect, without the professional machinery. We have not worked out how to talk to the deck yet. That part is honest.
products.priceDetail: The way in to the RX2 is not cracked yet, so there is nothing to price. Pricing waits on whether the bridge speaks USB or the network — the two need different hardware.
products.availability: Research — the RX2 integration is unsolved

products.title: Halo
products.description: An Astrolabe ring on the Colmi R09: a quiet interface for observing body-temperature patterns, checking in with yourself, and offering consent-led support to a partner. It pairs with LunaSay.
products.narration: Have you ever known you were getting ill a day before any symptoms? Your body often knows first. This ring watches the slow drift of your temperature and shows you the pattern. If you choose, someone who loves you can see it too.
products.priceDetail: Pairs with LunaSay. A reflective wellness instrument, not a medical device — temperature observations are not diagnoses. Partner sharing is opt-in, revocable, and always secondary to the wearer’s own judgment · members $125

products.title: LunaSay
products.description: A pocket astrolabe for the people you love, in two sizes: the 1.85B pocket instrument and a four-inch version. It pairs with the Halo ring, so what it tells you about the people you care for can be met with what your own body is doing.
products.narration: Who do you think of first thing in the morning? This is a small round thing for your pocket that keeps those few people close. Not a feed, not notifications. Just the handful who matter, and how they are doing.
products.priceDetail: Pocket 1.85B $229, four-inch $329 · members from $160 · pairs with the Halo ring

products.title: Fortun.ai
products.description: Ask what wants to be known. A small instrument for fortune telling, reflection, and the question you are carrying — an Astrolabe that answers obliquely, and on purpose.
products.narration: When you are stuck, have you ever wished someone would just ask you the right question? This one does not give answers. It asks. And what you catch yourself hoping it will say is usually the answer.
products.priceDetail: The 1.75C instrument with the Fortun.ai face · members $153

products.title: MARIA
products.description: MARIA is the figurine. Astrolabe is the device. Together they make a companion for attention, learning, and creation.
products.narration: Do you talk to yourself while you are working something out? Most of us do. MARIA is a small figure who sits on the shelf and listens. A face for the thing you are thinking with, so it is a companion rather than an app.
products.priceDetail: Beta $39 · members $104

products.title: Mynah
products.description: A private, ambient, voice-first companion for the home and pocket. Early units are being tested with a small circle.
products.narration: Would you say something private out loud in your own kitchen, if you were not sure who was listening? This is a small phone rebuilt to answer you without sending your voice anywhere. It is meant to hear you, and keep it here.
products.priceDetail: Sourced and provisioned: rooted, de-Googled, locked down and tested · members $314 · software alone, for a device you already own, $59

products.title: Hitchhiker's Guide to the Apocalypse
products.description: A physical book containing a LilyGo T-Deck — a book you can type into. Over LoRaWAN it reaches AI and the encyclopedia when there is no network left to reach them by.
products.narration: If the internet went down tomorrow, what would you actually lose? This is a book with a small computer inside it. It does not hold much on its own, but it can call across the room by radio to the cases on the bench, and read their whole library that way. No internet involved.
products.priceDetail: T-Deck bound into the book, LoRa antenna fitted · beta $59 · members $244

products.title: MynahVision
products.description: Mynah given eyes: a pan-and-tilt camera platform that can look where you point it and keep watch on what matters.
products.narration: Have you ever wanted to check on a room without a company's camera in it? This one turns to look where you point it, and answers to you rather than to a subscription.
products.priceDetail: Provisioned and ready to place · members $83 · software alone $39

products.title: Atlas
products.description: A field book with a landscape platform bound into it, open at a circular viewport. A living map of Castalia work, people and places, and the ground for temporal geography activities and adventures.
products.narration: How much do your children know about the ground under their feet? Not the country. The ground. This is a field book a child can carry outside, showing where they are and what was here before them. It arrives ready. There is nothing to set up.
products.priceDetail: An appliance, not an app: it arrives bound, provisioned and locked down, ready to hand to a child · members $419

products.title: Astrolabe firmware
products.description: Native firmware for the Castalia Institute Astrolabe device family: a tactile, glanceable instrument for inquiry.
products.narration: Have you ever had something stop working because the company that made it moved on? The instructions that run these instruments are written down, kept in one place, and stay ours. Nothing here can be switched off from somewhere else.
products.priceDetail: Open firmware for the Astrolabe family

products.title: OpenSCAD Playground
products.description: An in-browser OpenSCAD editor + preview with a conversation window that can propose and apply edits to the underlying model.
products.narration: Have you ever wanted to make a small thing that does not exist, a bracket or a replacement knob, and given up at the software? Here you describe it in words and it argues back until the shape is right. Then you print it.
products.priceDetail: Open in the browser, nothing to install

products.title: The Encyclopædia
products.description: A seasonal, multi-volume Encyclopædia demonstrating and inspiring inquiry: canonical public-domain authorship carried in the authentic voices of Faculty, with marginalia showing the scholarly conversation around it. Twelve volumes to the annual set, one a month, revised each Candlemas.
products.narration: When did you last look something up and genuinely trust the answer? We are writing an encyclopaedia. Twelve volumes a year, each entry in the voice of someone who spent a life on it, with the disagreements left in the margins where you can see them.
products.priceDetail: The annual twelve for $319 · at cost: print and shipping only, no markup

products.title: The Encyclopædia — Children’s Edition
products.description: The same topics and the same authors as the full edition, rewritten for reading comprehension without simplifying the idea.
products.narration: Have you noticed how children's books explain a little less each year? This is the same encyclopaedia written so a child can read it. The same subjects, the same authors, and none of the ideas made smaller.
products.priceDetail: The annual twelve for $289 · at cost, as the full edition

products.title: Feng Shui
products.description: Have you walked into a room and felt wrong in it, without knowing why? People have studied that for thousands of years. This is an instrument for measuring what a room is doing to you. It is research, and it is not for sale.
products.narration: Have you walked into a room and felt wrong in it, without knowing why? People have studied that for thousands of years. This is an instrument for measuring what a room is doing to you. It is research, and it is not for sale.
products.priceDetail: A research instrument, non-commercial and pre-product by its own specification. Back the research if you want it to exist.

products.title: The Garage
products.description: The physical workshop build: a 12 x 20 layout, its zones, ventilation logic, blueprint packages and phased construction.
products.narration: Where would a child in your house go to build something that needs a saw? For most of us the answer is nowhere. This is the plan for that room. Twelve feet by twenty, laid out so it is safe to work in, and drawn so you could build it.
products.priceDetail: Plans, cut lists, zoning and ventilation · $149 with the phased build guide

products.title: iNQshop / Garage Schooling
products.description: Curriculum strands from PreK upward, including engines and propulsion, notebooks, outputs and a growth pathway — taught in the bay.
products.narration: What did you learn at school that you still use? This is a curriculum for the room next door. Real tools, real projects, from about two years old up to engines. Less sitting down, more making.
products.priceDetail: Or $290 the year, per family · included at Institute membership

products.title: Maybe Something Seasonal
products.description: A calendar of nature’s cycles and the special moments through the year. Browse it by month, or subscribe to the MSS.ics feed — repeated observances are normalised into proper recurrence rules where the data proves a stable yearly pattern.
products.narration: Do you know when the next full moon is, or when the light starts coming back? Most of us have lost that. This is a calendar of the turning year, and you can subscribe to it so it simply appears alongside everything else.
products.priceDetail: The calendar and its ICS feed are free to use

products.title: Counterpoint
products.description: A compositional research project dedicated to new, original music through disciplined, historically grounded counterpoint practice.
products.narration: Can you learn to write music the way people did three hundred years ago and still say something new? That is the experiment. Old rules, strictly kept, to find out what those rules still know that we have forgotten.
products.priceDetail: Or $79 a year to support the whole output

products.title: Luminary
products.description: An illuminated coastal shadow box: sky over sea behind a 3D-printed silhouette that stands proud of the display. Location editions are made for particular places — the first is Cliff House, Maine.
products.narration: Is there a place you would go back to if you could? A coast, a view from a window. This is a lit box holding one of them: the sky, the sea, and the shape of that particular shoreline. The first is a house on the Maine coast.
products.priceDetail: Location editions to order · members $167

products.title: Lumen on iPhone
products.description: A personal, local AI that learns alongside its pupil: private by default, fast enough to feel conversational, battery-aware, and built around memory, retrieval and practice loops.
products.priceDetail: Software for a device you already own · members $41

products.title: Persona Reliquary
products.description: A sculptural vessel for an enduring voice. The Persona Reliquary is a physical embodiment of a digital persona, presented as a classical bust and housed beneath an inverted glass cloche.
products.narration: Is there someone whose voice you would want to keep? Not a recording. The way they would answer a question you had not asked yet. This is a small sculpture built to hold that, so a voice has somewhere to live.
products.priceDetail: Members $160

products.title: Atma Ambisonic
products.description: An immersive spatial audio system that captures and reproduces the full acoustic environment, enabling true three-dimensional soundscapes for virtual and augmented experiences.
products.narration: Can you remember what your grandmother's kitchen sounded like? Not a song, the room itself. This listens in every direction at once, so a place can be recorded whole and stepped back into later.
products.priceDetail: Beta $79 · members $384

products.title: Development MCP Tools
products.description: A collection of Model Context Protocol tools for developers, enabling seamless integration between AI assistants and development workflows.
products.narration: Have you ever explained the same thing to someone three times because they kept forgetting? That is most software. These are the small connectors that let a computer assistant remember where things are, and actually do the task rather than describe it.
products.priceDetail: Open source · back the work if it earns its keep

products.title: Noeticon
products.description: A ritual instrument for developmental readiness and learning attunement: a study of how thinking actually works, and what happens when you give it good instruments.
products.narration: Do you remember being genuinely curious about something, before anyone graded you on it? This is our attempt to study that: how thinking actually works, and what happens when you give it good instruments.
products.priceDetail: Free

products.title: iNQ — Classics in Inquiry
products.description: A continuous shelf of Homer, Virgil, Dante, Milton and Joyce: the old books treated as questions worth arguing with rather than monuments to admire.
products.narration: Were you ever handed a great book at exactly the wrong moment, and decided you hated it? These are the old ones, Homer and Dante and Joyce, treated as questions worth arguing with rather than monuments you are meant to admire.
products.priceDetail: Free
